_about: Search phrase bank for the demand scanner, Hebrew and English. Seeded from Yotam's principle (Nov 2026); Hebrew phrases are Claude drafts (confirmed:false) for Yotam to correct. The agent EXPANDS it from findings: add a phrase only if it appeared in a real listing or post (record where in `added_from`, no personal data); a phrase with zero yield over 3 runs becomes a candidate to drop (Yotam decides). Only used on sources whose automated reading is allowed in sources.json.
priority_rule: Highest priority: evidence of existing spend, significant lost time, or recurring demand from several owners. Signals: existing-spend (3), time-loss (2), willing-to-pay (2), recurring = 3+ distinct posters across 2+ sources (3). tiers: high >= 5, medium 3-4, low < 3. Priority ranks attention; it never claims revenue.
